# Dectorre

> Elevate Your Space — Premium embroidery wall décor and thread art for modern interiors. Refined embroidered art, decorative wall panels, and luxury wall decor by Dectorre.

Dectorre is a wall décor atelier. We create framed embroidery and textile wall art for homes and interiors. Orders are placed online; payment is arranged by email invoice. We do not offer cash on delivery.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.dectorre.com/): Brand overview and featured embroidery wall art
- [Shop](https://www.dectorre.com/embroidered-wall-art): Browse all embroidery wall décor and decorative wall panels
- [About](https://www.dectorre.com/about-us): Studio story and craft approach
- [Commissions](https://www.dectorre.com/commissions): Bespoke embroidery wall art enquiries
- [Contact](https://www.dectorre.com/contact-us): Email the studio — dectorreofficial@gmail.com
- [FAQ](https://www.dectorre.com/faq): Ordering, shipping, care, and returns answers

## Collections

- [Botanical Embroidered Wall Art](https://www.dectorre.com/botanical-embroidery-wall-art): Floral and garden textile panels
- [Wildlife Embroidered Wall Art](https://www.dectorre.com/wildlife-embroidery-wall-art): Birds, cranes, koi, and fauna motifs
- [Modern Embroidered Wall Art](https://www.dectorre.com/modern-embroidery-wall-art): Coastal, landscape, and contemporary compositions
